status: analysis policy lock; not a model; no version assigned

raceSelection.rule: retain every serialized OOS-selected race ID that exists in fixed D1; if any raceDate x venue has fewer than 5, fill by ascending raceNo until 5

probabilityModel.orderedCombinationMethod: Plackett-Luce using positive race-normalized modelP weights
probabilityModel.wide: sum all top-three ordered permutations containing the pair; model wide probabilities sum to three per race
probabilityModel.marketProbability: inverse JRA official odds normalized within bet type; wide normalized to total probability mass three; no estimated odds
probabilityModel.wideOddsForValue: JRA-published lower bound of the official wide odds range

rawOnlineExperts.blendWeightMeaning: weight on strict OOS model probability; 1-weight is weight on normalized JRA market probability

ticketValueMetaModel.candidatePoolPerRaceAndBetType: top 60 available official-odds combinations by raw score using 0.75 model probability + 0.25 normalized market probability; use all if fewer than 60
ticketValueMetaModel.target: binary indicator that the combination wins that bet type
features: constituent horses strict OOS modelP statistics and order positions
constituent horses strict OOS ptop3 statistics and order positions
constituent horses popularity and actual pre-race win-odds statistics
ticketValueMetaModel.learner: LightGBM binary classifier per bet type
ticketValueMetaModel.trainingRows: only candidate combinations from race dates strictly earlier than the prediction date; no same-date outcomes
ticketValueMetaModel.scoreAfterTraining: predicted hit probability * JRA official odds
ticketValueMetaModel.coldStartScore: raw 0.5 model / 0.5 market probability * JRA official odds

expertSelection.experts: five raw blend experts plus the ticket-value meta-model expert when trained
expertSelection.rule: for each course x bet type x raceDate choose the available expert with highest Bayesian-shrunk exponentially-decayed return using dates strictly before the current raceDate

ticketDiversification.allocation: rank tickets by the selected expert score, keep distinctTicketTarget tickets, then allocate 100-yen units round-robin from best to worst repeatedly while respecting the 300-yen per-ticket cap until the exact bet-type budget is exhausted; if the target tickets all reach cap, extend to the next-ranked distinct tickets and continue

officialOdds.missingOdds: remain missing and cannot be fabricated; skip missing combination and use the next ranked official-odds ticket

settlement.source: actual JRA payout rows already fixed in archive
